children: France medical implants maker's H1 revenue rose 23% yr/yr to €7.1 mln
Gross margin improved by 7 points to 59.5%, driven by JSS system and US growth
Operating loss narrowed by 13% despite higher commercial investments
IMPLANET plans to reinforce its U.S. commercial team and accelerate JAZZ rollout
Company aims to expand JAZZ platform distribution in China with Sanyou Medical
IMPLANET intends to launch SMTP Quntas ultrasonic scalpels for surgical revision and tumor surgery
JSS SYSTEM SALES - Co said strong performance of new JSS hybrid posterior fixation system drove spine implant revenue, with associated sales doubling yr/yr
MEDICAL EQUIPMENT GROWTH - Co said continued rollout of medical equipment distribution, notably SMTP ultrasonic scalpel, lifted segment revenue 27% yr/yr
US EXPANSION - Co said US revenue rose 54% yr/yr, driven by strong JSS system sales and expanded commercial activities
